title: Headcount
style: cinematic horror film still, old car ferry crossing a black harbor at night, thick drifting sea fog, sodium deck lights, wet steel, rope and rust, cold teal and amber tones, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. Twenty-three passengers boarded the last ferry. Twenty-four got off. ⛴️

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: The 11:40 ferry has room for a hundred people. Most nights, it carries twenty.
scenes.image: old car ferry at a fog-bound dock at night, deck lights glowing, a handful of passengers boarding

scenes.narration: Owen Pike is the deckhand. His job is simple. Count them on. Count them off. Write the numbers in the log.
scenes.image: young deckhand in an orange rain jacket and knit cap holding a metal tally clicker at the foot of a boarding ramp

scenes.narration: Tonight the fog is thick. The horn sounds every two minutes. Twenty-three passengers. Commuters. Two night-shift nurses. A man with a dog.
scenes.image: tired commuters in coats walking up a wet ferry ramp in fog, a man with a dog among them

scenes.narration: The crossing takes thirty-five minutes. Black water. Fog so thick the deck lights glow like dandelions.
scenes.image: ferry deck at night wrapped in dense fog, round hazy lights glowing along the railing

scenes.narration: Owen walks the deck twice. Nobody stands at the rail. Nobody ever does on the last ferry.
scenes.image: deckhand walking alone along an empty wet ferry deck, fog pressing against the rail

scenes.narration: They dock. Owen clicks them off, one by one. Twenty-two. Twenty-three. Twenty-four.
scenes.image: close-up of a deckhand's thumb pressing a metal tally clicker, passengers' legs walking past on a wet ramp

scenes.narration: The last one is a woman in an old-fashioned wool coat. Dripping wet. Her hair is wet. Her shoes leave puddles on the ramp.
scenes.image: woman in a 1950s-style wool coat with soaked hair walking down a ferry ramp, water dripping from her hem
dry dock boards under a lamp, a line of wet footprints crossing them

scenes.narration: She smiles at him like she's grateful. Then she walks up the dock, into the fog, and the fog takes her.
scenes.image: back of a woman in a long wool coat disappearing into thick fog at the end of a wooden dock

scenes.narration: Owen looks back at the empty ferry. On a bench where nobody sat, there's a wet shape. Like someone had been sitting there for a very long time.
scenes.image: empty wooden ferry bench under a deck light, soaked dark in the shape of a seated person, puddle beneath
